question: How many records were logged on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15';

question: How many records were logged per process step (aktion) on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT aktion, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' GROUP BY aktion ORDER BY n DESC, aktion;

question: How often does each status code occur on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' GROUP BY code ORDER BY n DESC, code;

question: How many unique serial numbers were processed at action 29 on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT serial) AS unique_units FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE aktion = 29 AND datum = '2026-07-15';

question: Which inspector (pruefer) logged the most records on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT pruefer, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' GROUP BY pruefer ORDER BY n DESC, pruefer LIMIT 1;

question: What are the 5 most frequent non-zero status codes in the week from 2026-07-09 to 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE code <> 0 AND datum BETWEEN '2026-07-09' AND '2026-07-15' GROUP BY code ORDER BY n DESC, code LIMIT 5;

question: How many records were logged per day from 2026-07-09 to 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT datum, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum BETWEEN '2026-07-09' AND '2026-07-15' GROUP BY datum ORDER BY datum;

question: Which 5 workstations (platz) processed the most distinct serial numbers on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT platz, COUNT(DISTINCT serial) AS n FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' GROUP BY platz ORDER BY n DESC, platz LIMIT 5;

question: How many records are there per process step and status code on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT aktion, code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' GROUP BY aktion, code ORDER BY aktion, code;

question: Which 10 serial numbers have the most records on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT serial, COUNT(*) AS steps FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' GROUP BY serial ORDER BY steps DESC, serial LIMIT 10;

question: Which serial numbers were processed at both action 1 and action 30 on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT sw1.serial FROM sw_alle_tabelle sw1 JOIN sw_alle_tabelle sw2 ON sw1.serial = sw2.serial AND sw1.datum = sw2.datum WHERE sw1.aktion = 1 AND sw2.aktion = 30 AND sw1.datum = '2026-07-15' ORDER BY sw1.serial;

question: What is the number of distinct serial numbers per hour of the start time on 2026-07-15?
gold_sql: SELECT HOUR(azeit) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(DISTINCT serial) AS run_rate FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND azeit IS NOT NULL GROUP BY HOUR(azeit) ORDER BY hour_of_day;

question: What is the average cycle time in minutes per process step (aktion) on 2026-07-15? Account for processes that cross midnight (end time earlier than start time).
gold_sql: SELECT aktion, AVG(CASE WHEN bzeit >= azeit THEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(bzeit, azeit)) ELSE TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(bzeit, azeit)) + 86400 END) / 60 AS avg_dlz_mins FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE azeit IS NOT NULL AND bzeit IS NOT NULL AND datum = '2026-07-15' GROUP BY aktion ORDER BY aktion;

question: What is the First Pass Yield (FPY) for action 22 on 2026-07-15? For each nonblank serial, use its earliest record with a start time (azeit). Break start-time ties by the smallest sw_index, then by product in ascending order. What percentage of those serials had status code '0' on that record? Include serials whose first record has a missing status in the denominator. Round the percentage to two decimal places.
gold_sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN code = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS passed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY serial ORDER BY azeit, sw_index, product ) AS rn FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE aktion = '22' AND datum = '2026-07-15' AND NULLIF(TRIM(serial), '') IS NOT NULL AND azeit IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(passed) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS fpy_percentage FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1;

question: How many serial numbers processed at action 1 on 2026-07-15 have no record at action 30 anywhere in the data?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sw1.serial) AS stuck_units FROM sw_alle_tabelle sw1 WHERE sw1.aktion = 1 AND sw1.datum = '2026-07-15' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sw_alle_tabelle sw2 WHERE sw2.serial = sw1.serial AND sw2.aktion = 30);

question: Which serial numbers were recorded at the same action step more than once on 2026-07-15? Show the Top 10
gold_sql: SELECT serial, aktion, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' GROUP BY serial, aktion HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY scan_count DESC, serial, aktion LIMIT 10;

question: For each failure record dated 2026-07-15 with a nonblank serial and action and a nonblank status code other than '0', measure the time from its end (bzeit) to the earliest status-'0' start (azeit) strictly after that end for the same serial and action. Require both start and end times on the failure. Treat datum as its start date and move its end to the next day when bzeit is earlier than azeit. Search across dates for the next success. Count each qualifying failure once and exclude failures with no later success. Average the elapsed seconds, then convert to minutes and round the final average to two decimal places.
gold_sql: WITH failure_ends AS ( SELECT serial, aktion, TIMESTAMP( CASE WHEN bzeit < azeit THEN DATE_ADD(datum, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ELSE datum END, bzeit ) AS failed_at FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND NULLIF(TRIM(serial), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(aktion), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(code), '') IS NOT NULL AND code <> '0' AND azeit IS NOT NULL AND bzeit IS NOT NULL ), recoveries AS ( SELECT f.serial, f.aktion, f.failed_at, ( SELECT TIMESTAMP(p.datum, p.azeit) FROM sw_alle_tabelle p WHERE p.serial = f.serial AND p.aktion = f.aktion AND p.code = '0' AND p.azeit IS NOT NULL AND p.datum >= DATE(f.failed_at) AND ( p.datum > DATE(f.failed_at) OR p.azeit > TIME(f.failed_at) ) ORDER BY p.datum, p.azeit LIMIT 1 ) AS recovered_at FROM failure_ends f GROUP BY f.serial, f.aktion, f.failed_at ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, f.failed_at, r.recovered_at)) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_recovery_mins FROM failure_ends f JOIN recoveries r ON r.serial = f.serial AND r.aktion = f.aktion AND r.failed_at = f.failed_at WHERE r.recovered_at IS NOT NULL;

question: For action 29 from 2026-07-09 through 2026-07-15, inclusive, which five nonblank status codes other than the text value '0' occurred most often? Show each code, its record count, and its percentage of all qualifying records, including records with codes outside the top five. Round each percentage to two decimal places. Sort by count descending and break ties by status code in ascending text order.
gold_sql: SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS occurrences, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE aktion = '29' AND datum BETWEEN '2026-07-09' AND '2026-07-15' AND NULLIF(TRIM(code), '') IS NOT NULL AND code <> '0' GROUP BY code ORDER BY occurrences DESC, code LIMIT 5;

question: Which serial numbers were processed at action 30 on 2026-07-15 but never have a record at action 29 with status code 0?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT sw1.serial FROM sw_alle_tabelle sw1 WHERE sw1.aktion = 30 AND sw1.datum = '2026-07-15' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sw_alle_tabelle sw2 WHERE sw2.serial = sw1.serial AND sw2.aktion = 29 AND sw2.code = 0) ORDER BY sw1.serial;

question: How many action 29 records on 2026-07-15 have a serial number that is null, empty, or contains only spaces?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_serial_records FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND aktion = '29' AND NULLIF(TRIM(serial), '') IS NULL;

question: How many action 22 records on 2026-07-15 started at or after 06:00 and before 14:00?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS shift_records FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND aktion = '22' AND azeit >= '06:00:00' AND azeit < '14:00:00';

question: How many records on 2026-07-15 are missing a start time, an end time, or both? Count each record once.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS incomplete_time_records FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND (azeit IS NULL OR bzeit IS NULL);

question: On 2026-07-15, which five products had the most distinct nonblank revisions? Show the product and revision count, include only products with at least two revisions, and break ties by product.
gold_sql: SELECT product, COUNT(DISTINCT rev) AS revision_count FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND NULLIF(TRIM(rev), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rev) >= 2 ORDER BY revision_count DESC, product LIMIT 5;

question: For action 29 on 2026-07-15, which five workstations had the highest percentage of records with a status other than '0'? Exclude blank workstations and statuses. Include only workstations with at least 10 recorded statuses. Show the total, the count with a status other than '0', and the percentage rounded to two decimals. Break ties by workstation.
gold_sql: SELECT platz, COUNT(*) AS total_records, SUM(CASE WHEN code <> '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonzero_records, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN code <> '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS nonzero_pct FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND aktion = '29' AND NULLIF(TRIM(platz), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(code), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY platz HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY nonzero_pct DESC, platz LIMIT 5;

question: From 2026-07-09 through 2026-07-15, for each day with a nonblank serial and status at action 29, how many distinct serials had status '0' and how many had another status? A serial can count in both groups.
gold_sql: SELECT datum, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN code = '0' THEN serial END) AS zero_status_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN code <> '0' THEN serial END) AS nonzero_status_units FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum BETWEEN '2026-07-09' AND '2026-07-15' AND aktion = '29' AND NULLIF(TRIM(serial), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(code), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY datum ORDER BY datum;

question: On 2026-07-15, which 10 serials were scanned at the most distinct workstations for action 29? Exclude blank serials and workstations, include only serials scanned at two or more workstations, and break ties by serial.
gold_sql: SELECT serial, COUNT(DISTINCT platz) AS workstation_count FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND aktion = '29' AND NULLIF(TRIM(serial), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(platz), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY serial HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT platz) >= 2 ORDER BY workstation_count DESC, serial LIMIT 10;

question: What was the busiest start hour for each action on 2026-07-15? Show the action, hour, and record count. Ignore blank actions and missing start times. Choose the earlier hour when counts tie.
gold_sql: WITH hourly AS ( SELECT aktion, HOUR(azeit) AS start_hour, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND azeit IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(aktion), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY aktion, HOUR(azeit) ), ranked AS ( SELECT aktion, start_hour, record_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY aktion ORDER BY record_count DESC, start_hour) AS rn FROM hourly ) SELECT aktion, start_hour, record_count FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY aktion;

question: For every date from 2026-07-09 through 2026-07-15, show the daily and cumulative count of action 30 records. Include dates with zero records and start the cumulative count on 2026-07-09.
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE calendar AS ( SELECT CAST('2026-07-09' AS DATE) AS log_date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(log_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM calendar WHERE log_date < '2026-07-15' ), daily_counts AS ( SELECT datum, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum BETWEEN '2026-07-09' AND '2026-07-15' AND aktion = '30' GROUP BY datum ) SELECT c.log_date, COALESCE(d.record_count, 0) AS daily_records, SUM(COALESCE(d.record_count, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY c.log_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_records FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN daily_counts d ON d.datum = c.log_date ORDER BY c.log_date;

question: How many distinct nonblank serials had an action 30 start strictly after an action 1 start on 2026-07-15? Both starts must be recorded on that day.
gold_sql: WITH first_action AS ( SELECT serial, MIN(azeit) AS first_start FROM sw_alle_tabelle WHERE datum = '2026-07-15' AND aktion = '1' AND azeit IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(serial), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY serial ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_units FROM first_action f WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sw_alle_tabelle s WHERE s.serial = f.serial AND s.datum = '2026-07-15' AND s.aktion = '30' AND s.azeit > f.first_start );
